skills.skill_desc:
Hilda recovers 2% HP per second while in the bush. Entering a bush enhances her next Basic Attack, which deals 110<font color="fba51f"> (+130% Total Physical Attack)</font><font color="ffe63c">(+12*Hero Level)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target, reduces the target's Movement Speed by 40%, and deals 40<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font><font color="ffe63c">(+10*Hero Level)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies behind the target. After using the enhanced Basic Attack, this effect enters a 6s cooldown.

Hilda's Basic Attack and skills apply a <font color="a6aafb">Wilderness Mark</font> on hit, which lasts up to 4s and stacks up to 6 times. Each stack reduces the enemy hero's <font color="26e407"><1999></font> by 3%.
Hilda gains 60% Movement Speed for 3s and receives a shield that absorbs damage equal to 10% <font color="26e407"><1005></font>, lasting 3s.

Hilda locks onto an enemy target, dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+90% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> per hit. This skill can be cast up to 3 times. The 2nd attack deals extra damage to nearby enemies. The 3rd attack deals damage to the target and nearby enemies, knocking them back briefly.

Hilda launches a powerful slash at the target enemy, dealing 600<font color="fba51f"> (+250% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and stunning them for 0.2s. Nearby enemies take 60% of the damage.

Each stack of <font color="a6aafb">Wilderness Mark</font> increases <font color="a6aafb">Power of Wildness</font>'s damage by 2.5% of the target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font>. At max stacks, the extra damage increases to 20% of the target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font>.
